target.statement: Gemini-1.5-Pro achieves an overall score of 45.3 on the ToolBH benchmark (Table 2, Overall column).

compute.basis: The target requires querying the Gemini-1.5-Pro API on 700 samples (3 levels each), which is API-bound and can be done on a CPU laptop, but the exact score depends on the proprietary model's outputs and the evaluation code must be reconstructed from the paper.

blockers: Requires access to the proprietary Gemini-1.5-Pro API (closed-source model)
Evaluation code for the benchmark is not fully released; must be reimplemented from the paper
Exact reproduction of the score may vary due to API version changes
title: ToolBeHonest: A Multi-level Hallucination Diagnostic Benchmark for Tool-Augmented Large Language Models
